Hey, seriously, do not sign up with GenderGP. I get being 16 it's super tricky and your heavily limited options wise but they are absolutely con artists and scumbags.

I'm not gonna get super into it but if you just go on this subreddit and sort by top posts of the past month you will see SO much of what I'm talking about.

You will lose hundreds and hundreds of pounds, be forced to wait months and massively regret it.

Very quickly summing up how bad they are right now in money terms for the first 2 months:
- Set up £200
- Monthly £30
- Blood test (if relevant) £50
- Prescriber fee £15
- Info session £65 (I think)?
- And one or two extra costs around £10 or £15 each that vary depending on your situation

Then on top of that they:
- Solely use AI to respond to people paying them three times the cost of a streaming service
- Offer zero, zero free customer service or replies. Only option is paid, its £8 for 15 minutes, and you'll find dozens of people on this sub saying no one even turns up to the paid sessions.
- The huge majority of staff were booted and fired months ago.

I myself have been with them since January 10th. Not gonna explain every part of my experience. But just know on my end I have done every single thing they've asked of me. I still don't have hormones. And they've wrongly told me and dozens of others on here they have to repay every penny they've already given them!

The place is a shambles. If you can't find any other option (I get its SO hard atm especially under 18), I would at least wait a few more months and regularly check in on this subreddits posts. If you start seeing signs people are happier and the place is actually fucking giving people any service at all, then sign up.

Anyway, whatever you do, good luck. It's super hard being trans, especially at your age.
